main_text.p: tate[?] fultus: sed decimo qvinto post do-nationem anno ab Innocentio IV. restitu-tam fuisse Comiti Raimundo, eadem au-thoritate probavi, quæ quoniam ibidem luculenter narrantur, importunus essem otioque tuo abuterer, illustrissime Card. si huc ista repeterem. Quidquid sit, judicio tuo cadere aut stare volo. Ante-quam tamen scribendi finem faciam, Il-lustr. Reverentiam tuam etiam atque etiam rogo, ut me Symbolum meum, æra scilicet minuta duo in Domini gazophy-lacio conferentem, pilosq; caprarum in ædificium portantem favore & patroci-nio tuo protegas; præjudicium enim quod concepisti facile obliteratum iri non dubito. Te Deus quam diutissime Ecclesiæ suæ conservet. Parisiis sexto Kal. Augusti, 1630.
main_text.head: EPIST. XXVIII.

head.i: Renatus Geraldus J. Morino, De iis quæ Romani Aulici in ejus Libro notaverunt.

page.notes: The catchword at the lower right is partly legible, the last letter is doubtful. A dark ink blot covers part of "quod" in the line "quod concepisti". The first word of the page is a fragment, "tate", and its continuation is doubtful. The running head "Jo. Morino." is taken from the printed top line. The date line ends in a full stop as printed. No marginal notes are present. A faint line at the very bottom of the page is scan edge or show-through and is not transcribed.
